title: Pick the center stone right in Rhino

hook.text: Pick the center stone right in Rhino

post.youtube_title: Pick the center stone right in Rhino
post.caption:
Press Pick on the HeyGema toolbar, choose CenterStone and select the stone in your Rhino viewport. Then give it its own color, here a pink sapphire, and render.

Install it in Rhino: type PackageManager, search heygema and click Install.
How it works: https://www.heygema.com/en/rhino?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=shorts&utm_campaign=yt-rhino-pick
